identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route operators to canonical Runtime v3 service control

values.summary: Rewrite the runbook around the stable current-generation Rust CSM command, make legacy shell Runtime verbs refuse with exact replacement guidance, preserve Observatory commands, and add narrow guards.

steps.action: Replace stale Runtime lifecycle guidance with canonical current-generation Rust CSM status, start, stop, reload, path, label, and identity proof.
Make legacy CSMctl Runtime verbs refuse with canonical replacement commands while preserving Observatory-only behavior.
Add focused routing/docs guards, run canonical ownership tests and quality checks, obtain exact-head review, and publish a ready green PR.

invariants: The Rust csm runtime-v3 controller remains sole permanent Runtime authority
Legacy shell commands never claim a different service as canonical
Validation never changes the live Runtime
risks: Legacy callers may depend on CSMctl start
Documentation may accidentally mix demo and permanent layouts
A wrapper delegation could recurse or resolve the wrong binary
stop_conditions: Implementation would alter canonical ownership behavior
Scope expands beyond routing docs and tests
